skills.description: This skill should be used when the user (an IFA/wealth advisor) needs to quickly look up Hong Kong insurance product recommendations based on client needs, or understand the IFA HK insurance solution framework (Object-Relation-Action three-layer structure). Contains the client need → product mapping table (v2 verified), product comparison data (AIA/AXA/MassMutual/China Taiping/etc.), compliance requirements (837 order, cross-border fund routing, onshore signing rules), and solution architecture patterns for different client profiles (business owners, high-income families, cross-border families). This is a practitioner's quick-reference tool, not a consumer-facing guide. Triggered by keywords like 港险产品, 港险方案, 产品对比, 产品速查, 837号令, 友邦, 安盛, 分红险, 储蓄险, 香港保险配置.
